description: Return the reference of the Graph Paper plot document format, as Markdown: every field of a plot document, the series types, the limits, and complete examples. Give section to get one section only (a heading of the page, such as "Variables" or "2D Series Types"); an unknown section returns the list of headings. Read it before you write a document for make_plot_link.

section.description: A heading of the format page. Leave it out for the whole page.

name: get_plot_format
title: Read the plot document format
